project_type: Home Assistant custom integration (BLE media player)
build_system: None (custom component, no build step; py_compile for syntax validation)
build_command: python -m py_compile custom_components/tcl_soundbar/media_player.py && python -m py_compile custom_components/tcl_soundbar/protocol.py && python -m py_compile custom_components/tcl_soundbar/__init__.py
verification_instructions: 1. Run py_compile on all .py files in custom_components/tcl_soundbar/. 2. Run pytest tests/test_protocol.py. 3. Verify all 22 tests pass.
setup_instructions: pyenv global 3.11.15 to set Python version. No pip install needed - tests mock HA dependencies.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. No Home Assistant runtime available - tests stub out HA modules with MagicMock. py_compile is sufficient for syntax validation.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Keep code style consistent with existing patterns.
key_patterns: TCLSoundbarProtocol is a class with all @staticmethod methods serving as a namespace. TDataMerger is stateful. Tests use sys.modules mocking to avoid needing real HA install. The integration uses HA's bluetooth dependency (manifest.json). Config flow stores BLE address in entry.data['address'].
directory_structure: custom_components/tcl_soundbar/ - integration code. tests/ - test files. apk/ - reference APK from TCL app (not part of integration code).
